title_ko: 플로라 기어 노멀 · 가슴 꽃 매립 수정

references.role: Sole original edit target; preserve composition, identity, body proportions, poses, clothing, scissors, labels and back view.

visual_qa.hero: External upper/lower caps and glass sidewall replaced with a slim gold-edged window embedded in the ivory torso.
visual_qa.front: Flower window sits within the sternum rather than as a strapped-on canister.
visual_qa.side: Forward projection of cylinder and caps substantially reduced; shallow window follows the slim chest contour.
visual_qa.flower: One blue flower, green stem and leaves remain readable in each applicable view. Window outline is smaller after cap removal; flower has not been hidden.
visual_qa.preserved: Normal face, cap, curls, neck/body proportions, clothes, scissors, pose, sheet layout and rear winding key remain consistent.
visual_qa.scope: Normal only; hard concepts and the historical source PNG remain unchanged.

limits: AI-edited 2D character sheet. Actual 3D cavity depth, mesh construction and rigging not tested.
